title: Global ML Freestanding Partitions — 66"H, 6-Office Configuration
body_html:
Turn one open floor into six defined offices with freestanding 66"-high panels that go up without a single contractor.

This Global ML partition package arrives pre-configured as three 60"-wide back panels and eight 48"-wide side panels, framing six private workstations in a single layout. Fabric-upholstered tiles come in seven colours for acoustic separation and a clean visual identity, while steel frames in Black, Designer White, or Tungsten ride on flat or mobile feet. Made in Canada, it gives institutional buyers a reconfigurable alternative to fixed walls.

Key features

  • 66"H panels divide open floor plates into six defined office zones
  • Pre-configured as 3 back panels (60"W) and 8 side panels (48"W)
  • Side panels also available in 24" and 36" widths for flexible layouts
  • Three frame and foot finishes: Black, Designer White, Tungsten
  • Seven fabric tile colours for acoustic privacy and workspace identity
  • Flat-foot and mobile-foot supports for fixed or reconfigurable setups

Who it’s for

Open-plan offices in municipal, education, and healthcare settings that need to carve six private workstations out of a shared floor plate without permanent construction.

Office Central and Brant Business Interiors are verified OECM partners, so Ontario’s public sector can buy without an open tender. Call 1-800-835-9565 for a quote.

_meta.notes: SKU GLB-3@ML6660+8@ML6648FFP is a configured bundle: 3x ML6660 (60"W back panels) + 8x ML6648FFP (48"W side panels), 66"H. Existing_body_html is the authoritative source and is fully consistent with the title (66" partitions, 6 offices, fabric finishes, Made in Canada). The 'ML' code is a freestanding fabric-panel/screen system — NOT the ML lounge-seating series (Richard Eppstadt) at globalfurnituregroup.com/products/ml; do not conflate. WebSearch on globalfurnituregroup.com did not surface an isolated named series page for these exact ML panel codes; the Universal Privacy Panels page confirmed Global's freestanding 66"H / 60"W panel format and Limited Lifetime Warranty, hence source_url. Certifications left empty — Global commonly carries GREENGUARD/BIFMA but neither was confirmable for this specific line, so flagged in missing. Panel depth not stated in source. dimensions field gives panel widths/heights only.
